validInclusionBlocks.interpretation: Slot retention does not retain a lifetime block list. Exact block coverage is in terminal evidence; no interior/steady TPS is inferred.

processCPU.scope: RUSAGE_SELF process user/system CPU includes client HTTP, observer, decoder, Go runtime and GC; excludes separate nodes/other processes. Two cumulative samples bracket the client measurement; neither CPU nor wall durations are additive phase attribution.

submissionOccupancy.scope: Original paced submit callback entry/return wall occupancy across workers; busy durations overlap and are not pure server/network/CPU. Queue wait sums actual offered-to-submit monotonic intervals for callbacks with a start timestamp; unfinished/unoffered inputs are not invented.

runtime.interpretation: CPU/occupancy include stream setup and close; cumulative ready window is nested inside it. Resource case also charges full evidence readback and cleanup. No pure node/GC cost or sustained capacity inference.

logicalPrivateByteAccounting: Logical retained file stat.st_size plus original receipts; free filesystem blocks independently sampled by statvfs and reserve floors. Not an allocated-block or cgroup hard ceiling.

timeSeries.interpretation: Process-local monotonic one-second event counts, reconstructed from submission plus actual measured latency. Inclusion/final require the existing business gates. Terminal time is controller hand-back after the evidence sink. AwaitingTerminal is offered minus hand-backs; OfferedNotYetFinal includes failed outcomes and is not a mempool size. Idle gaps and partial trailing seconds remain explicit. Any unavailable/invalid event withholds the entire series. This is client observation timing, not an internal consensus timer or proof of sustained capacity.

originalStreamMemberManifest.encoding: sha256 of canonical sorted-key compact JSON descriptors(path,bytes,sha256), each followed by LF; intent sequence then terminal sequence; not a whole-ZIP digest

nextAction: Explicit original bounded-cadence stream CODE and focused tests based on measured timer drift. Same-VM relative/bounded pair wiring and a new exact Root grant remain necessary; no candidate performance inference.
interpretation: Original complete8192 records plus four original Comet block tx counts/post-execution app hashes and next-header committed-state hashes all agree. Comet0.38.23 committed-state log atH prints block.AppHash, the H-1 post-state; this is not a same-height post-state hash. Node distributions separate business-bearing blocks from empty warmup/drain blocks; validation child times are nested in Commit. Means/gaps use each original transaction before aggregation; interval quantiles are original bounded1ms histograms. Phase wall totals/CPU/node totals overlap and must not be summed as critical-path finality. First-node deadline follows from the all-eight-spawned upper bound, not an invented direct timestamp. One finite low actual offer window, no matched improvement or sustained TPS claim.
